sketches.mechanism: A single object is declared both const and volatile: the program may not assign to it, but every read must still be performed because it may change outside the program's control.
sketches.resonance: It waits for a state only the outside world can alter.

sketches.mechanism: A constrained subtype rejects an initialization value outside its declared range, producing a constraint violation before normal execution.
sketches.resonance: The hand is defined smaller than the want it is asked to hold.

sketches.mechanism: An empty datatype has no constructors, so the absurd pattern handles a case that can never be supplied.
sketches.resonance: From absence anything could follow, but absence never arrives to speak.
